Sep 2017 • Family
From the main road all you see is a tiny alley going somewhere. Once you turn the corner in the alley, a restaurant can be seen. As you walk in you see it is a huge restaurant. Many different sections and playground for children.

Wonderful Family Get Away Dining Experience
Feb 2017 • Family
For a large group, especially with kids, this is a great get away spot. The restaurant has different pagoda sections for dining groups around a man-made lake. It's quite pretty.
The food was surprisingly good as I expected it to be more about the ambience. The mixed appetizer plate was excellent, but my favorite was the crab hot hot with an abundance mix of mushrooms.
The staff was very attentive, especially for my elderly parents. They even pulled the crab meat out for them. Our cups of beer were always full.
It certainly helped to go with a local family. I don't think the staff speaks English.
So, if you can go with some locals , well worth a visit with a large group.

Avoid this restaurant!
Mar 2016 • Family
I have been to this place 2 or 3 times in the past couple of years but each time the only good things about it are the "man made lake" in the middle and ...leaving!

Immediately upon arrival last night the general attitude of the supervisory staff was demeaning, arrogant and outright rudeness. Smirking at each other when we were discussing their "corkage" fees, extra charges for snack foods we brought in (traditional Vietnamese items) to munch on while waiting for dinner. Corkage fees means no service! On arrival asking for a beer to start off with means serving one beer at a time! 
Having seen the sneering by staff I asked to speak to the Manager in charge. A man arrived (and he looked like he had just fallen off a truck) and having introduced myself as a fellow hospitality professional and giving my business card and I expected he would do the same however no I had to ask who he was and upon asking for his card was told he left them in the office. I explained that their were already distinct service issues with the supervisors! He gave some apology although it was clear from his body language he didn't mean it. I asked him to ensure service that evening went very well as it was a special birthday, to which he replied it would all be ok? It was not! To get staff to actually do anything you have to ask; from offering drinks, to clearing dirty dishes and basically being proactive around the table!!

I asked for a copy of his card and was told he would bring it later.... he never came back to the table and we never saw him again.

Service continued to be next to non-existent and by the end of the dinner, which contained very poor quality local food dishes, served very slow, most hot food was cold or really not up to standards.

I had another booking for Saturday 12/03 which involved senior managers with my company and after the experience last night I have decided to cancel. Incidentally they demand deposits to make reservations and additional deposits to book certain seating and... Yes they take a deposit for food!! even if you haven't selected your menu you pay a deposit! They say all deposits are non-refundable but don't issue and agreement or contracts?

The owners of this place need to know their general manager and the service staff have the attitude - we are not here for the guest, they need us more than we need them!

I have not included every detail on the experience, but I assure you... service, hygiene, rude staff, poor quality food are just some of the issues they have; the only staff who gave good service was the bike parking staff who were

I will never return! It's a shame because the place has potential!

Nice hidden place in District 8 Saigon with ponds with fish
Apr 2015 • Couples
You can not see this restaurant from the street as it is hidden down a long alley way. Once back there this restaurant can cater to over 600 people with ease. It has huge lakes for kids to fish and even cook their fish caught. Each pond has a water mill circulating the water. The waiters are on roller skates as the restaurant is so big. People that pick up dirty dishes are on bicycles. The menu is all Vietnamese serving lunch and dinner. The food is very cheap and very good. Try it one time and you will love it.

Jan 2015 • Friends
Attended this restaurant with family friends . Very nice place, clean, tidy, although very busy (it was New Years Day), had attractions that interested the kids that were with us. Highly recommended, although off the beaten track for tourists, perhaps. Having married into a Vietnamese family it wasn't for me!.
Fine selection of fish dishes and the beer was cold, waitress, helpful, friendly and efficient and the food was just fine.
Price - excellent - 3,000,000 VND (GBP89/USD137) for FIFTEEN people (GBP6/USD9 per person) including drinks that's pretty good.
 
As an aside, for the ladies there is a shop next to the entrance selling good shoes, buy one - get one free average price 400,000/500.000 VND per pair (GBP15/USD23 for TWO pairs of ladies shoes-ain't bad!).).
